properties.label: 东汉钱塘城
properties.sourceTitle: 杭州历代城界：图件、配准与考古核对
properties.status: 1985年历史地理研究图转绘 · 图示参考，非实测墙界
properties.enStatus: Digitized historical-geography sketch (1985); not a surveyed wall boundary
properties.note: 重描虞家钧《杭州沿革和城市发展》（1985）图2中带＋记号的东汉城垣线，保留西侧折转及南缘弯折，不沿清旗营点线或邻接宫城线。按原图2公里比例尺等比转换，以钱塘门地段近似平移落位；图面北向为方向假定，不作多点仿射拉伸。绝对位置、城垣复原学说及图件比例误差仍待核，不能当作考古实测范围。不新增东汉国都身份。
properties.enNote: Redigitized the dashed, plus-marked Eastern Han circuit in Yu Jiajun’s 1985 Fig. 2, preserving western and southern bends. Uniform scale from its 2 km scale bar; approximate translation using the Qiantang Gate vicinity and assumed map north. No affine shear. Absolute placement and the historical reconstruction remain uncertain; not an excavated boundary or evidence of national-capital status.
properties.locationPrecision: 按原图比例尺、图面北向及钱塘门地段近似落位；无独立考古城界控制

properties.label: 南宋临安城
properties.sourceTitle: 杭州历代城界：图件、配准与考古核对
properties.status: 研究图件配准参考 · 非考古实测墙界
properties.enStatus: Georeferenced research drawing; not a surveyed archaeological boundary
properties.note: 按王子奇《宋代城镇考古的发现与研究（上）》图二所载整城复原图描绘完整轮廓，用钱塘门遗址及清波、新门、艮山门地段作现代对应参照。原图南北比例为示意，北部先以地望参照拟合，南部再对应皇城考古图分区配准，中间作图面过渡。约56米残差仅检验北部所选参照，不等于全城墙界精度；整城图含文献复原和未探明地段，虚线及淡填充统一提示研究性质。它不是明清城界的复制。德寿宫东侧2006／2025年考古地段仍独立保留，钱塘门沿用既有坐标并对新轮廓邻段作局部约束；既有地点不是原始考古测量点，不用来宣称每段已校准；西南山地、南部城郭及相关门址仍需发掘测绘图进一步校核。
properties.enNote: Complete circuit traced from Figure 2 in Wang Ziqi’s archaeological review and approximately registered using the existing Qiantang Gate location and Qingbo, Xin and Genshan gate vicinities. The source is schematic, so its southern district is separately registered against the palace diagram, with a transition between drawing regions. The roughly 56 m RMS tests only the selected northern references, not the full boundary. Dashed lines and pale fill identify a documentary reconstruction with unexcavated parts, not a copy of the Ming–Qing enclosure. The 2006 / 2025 east-wall excavation vicinity is retained separately. The existing Qiantang location is preserved and locally constrains the new outline, without implying original survey accuracy. Mountain and southern portions remain subject to archaeological checking.
properties.boundaryEvidence: 整城复原图完整轮廓；非全圈实测

properties.sourceName: 南宋皇城（大内复原范围）
properties.label: 南宋皇城（大内）
properties.enSourceName: Southern Song Imperial Palace: Reconstructed Enclosure
properties.sourceTitle: 杭州历代城界：图件、配准与考古核对
properties.status: 研究图件配准参考 · 非考古实测墙界
properties.enStatus: Georeferenced research drawing; not a surveyed archaeological boundary
properties.note: 整城复原图中的大内完整轮廓，按和宁、丽正与西侧门址的图示对应，局部对照皇城历年考古成果图，再以现代街巷配准。图上门名及西侧门址归属存在解释差异，三点对应能拟合不代表城界精度。显示面北、东、南三边优先沿考古成果图转绘墙段，缺口仅在参考面中补接，二十段原始转绘开放线不改；西边仍是文献图自然屏障推定。此面仅为大内范围的近似位置，不是全部皇城后苑的已确认外界；西部天然山体与圣果寺等后苑遗存的统属及完整边界仍待考古图件补核，不将现有圣果寺标绘挪入或裁掉。各考古墙段另以开放线显示。
properties.enNote: Complete Danei contour from the documentary reconstruction, locally related to the archaeological diagram through the northern, southern and western gate positions, then registered to modern streets. Gate identification and the western gate’s name remain interpretive. An exact three-point correspondence is not accuracy evidence. The displayed face follows the archaeology-diagram wall traces on its north, east and south, with explicit gap joins only in the inferred face. The twenty open transcriptions are unchanged. The western natural barrier remains documentary. This is the approximate extent of the palace enclosure, not an archaeologically confirmed boundary of all western hills and gardens. Existing Shengguo Temple geometry is preserved; its wider enclosure relationship remains unresolved. Archaeological drawing segments are shown separately.
properties.boundaryEvidence: 大内文献图闭合轮廓；后苑完整外界待核

properties.sourceName: 南宋皇城考古探明墙段
properties.label: 皇城考古墙段
properties.enSourceName: Southern Song Palace: Archaeologically Located Wall Segments
properties.sourceTitle: 杭州历代城界：图件、配准与考古核对
properties.status: 考古成果图转绘配准 · 20段开放线，非原始测绘GIS
properties.enStatus: Registered archaeology-diagram transcription; 20 open segments, not original survey GIS
properties.note: 按《南宋皇城遗址历年考古调查勘探试掘地点及成果》图中红色城垣带逐段描中心线，保留全部20段图示缺口。原图是考古成果分布图，但本地图新增线是经街巷参照配准后的图面转绘，非考古单位原始GIS，也不是按已知墙宽生成实测墙体面。宫墙与城外京城墙、德寿宫墙分开；未探明的西部天然山体没有强行画成墙线。
properties.enNote: Twenty separate centreline traces digitized from the red wall bands in the published palace archaeology diagram. Every selected gap is retained. The underlying diagram summarizes archaeological work, but these map lines are registered drawing transcriptions, not the excavation team’s GIS or measured wall-body polygons. Unmapped natural western barriers are not drawn as excavated walls.

properties.label: 余杭门
properties.sourceTitle: 杭州历代城界：图件、配准与考古核对
properties.status: 研究图件配准参考 · 非考古实测墙界
properties.enStatus: Georeferenced research drawing; not a surveyed archaeological boundary
properties.note: 南宋十三座旱门之一，按整城复原图所标方位配准到相应城界；为图示门址参照，非已发掘门洞中心。各期移门另列，不直接采用明清同名城门坐标。亦俗称北关门，非吴越旧夹城巷北关门。 为保持图面关联，按原图方位投影到相应参考城界；此位置不是门基实测。
properties.enNote: One of the thirteen land gates, placed from the full-city reconstruction on its corresponding drawn circuit. This is a research-drawing position, not an excavated doorway centre. Projected to the matching reference circuit for map association, not a surveyed doorway.

properties.label: 隋代杭州城墙
properties.sourceTitle: 杭州历代城界：图件、配准与考古核对
properties.status: 1985年研究图转绘 · 开放图示参照，非实测墙界
properties.enStatus: 1985 research-map digitization; open reference, not a surveyed boundary
properties.note: 重新辨读虞家钧1985年图2的隋代点划线，按同图原比例尺与钱塘门地段近似落位，保留可辨认的北、东及绕吴山折转段；不把吴山东侧线改成现代河道，也不复制东汉＋记号或海塘。采用该文“大城”解释；后续研究另有凤凰山州城与湖东北县城分立说，本线不代表学界定论。南部线型叠压、图注遮挡及未辨认段不补画，不闭合、不填充。只是研究图示，非考古墙基实测；不新增隋代国都身份。
properties.enNote: Redigitized identifiable Sui dash-dot portions in Yu Jiajun’s 1985 Fig.2, using its scale and an approximate Qiantang Gate translation. Retains northern/eastern stretches and the bend around Wushan. The study’s large-city interpretation is disputed by the separate southern prefectural city/northern county city model. Ambiguous, obscured or unidentifiable southern portions remain open, unfilled and undrawn. Not surveyed footings or national-capital status.
properties.locationPrecision: 按原图比例尺、图面北向及钱塘门地段近似落位；无独立考古城界控制

properties.label: 吴越罗城东城墙
properties.sourceTitle: 杭州历代城界：图件、配准与考古核对
properties.status: 1985年研究图转绘 · 开放图示参照，非实测墙界
properties.enStatus: 1985 research-map digitization; open reference, not a surveyed boundary
properties.note: 1985年图2中吴越罗城的东侧长虚线重新转绘；与相邻带＋号的防洪大塘分开，不启用此前撤下的候选线。沿原图2公里比例尺等比落位，绝对位置仍有数百米量级图示误差，不能作为城门与墙基精确坐标。图上北端出图、南部山地与夹城连接未完整辨认，故保持开放、不填充，不用南宋城墙或现代海塘补闭合。893年始筑，吴越时期沿用；完整夹城与罗城西南山地圈待可靠图件。
properties.enNote: New digitization of the eastern long-dash Wuyue Luocheng line in Yu’s 1985 Fig.2, separated from the adjoining plus-marked flood dike. Previously withdrawn candidate lines remain withdrawn. Uniform original-map scale, with approximate translation and potentially several-hundred-metre placement error. The northern end is clipped and the southern mountain/Jiacheng connection remains unresolved, so no closure or fill is added. Begun in 893 and used during Wuyue; not substituted with Song walls or a modern dike.
properties.locationPrecision: 按原图比例尺、图面北向及钱塘门地段近似落位；无独立考古城界控制

properties.sourceName: 吴越杭州罗城（研究复原）
properties.label: 吴越杭州罗城
properties.sourceTitle: 杭州文史：子城、夹城、罗城——吴越杭城三步曲（2026）
properties.status: 2026年文史研究图转绘 · 图示参考，非实测墙界
properties.enStatus: 2026 historical-study drawing; schematic reference, not surveyed walls
properties.note: 依据杭州文史微信公众号、杭州文史网2026年1月26日《子城、夹城、罗城——吴越杭城三步曲》所附“钱镠所修罗城图”转绘完整示意轮廓。该图与用户提供截图的北部突出、南部山地城圈关系相近，用来核对范围关系，未宣称找到截图原出处。以宝石山、吴山、凤凰山、玉皇山的图示山峰和OSM峰顶作等比旋转平移；四点残差约72—316米。鼓楼独立参照相差约140米，仍不能证明城墙精度。峰顶符号、古今地名对应及原图本身均有解释误差。闭合仅表达此文的罗城复原方案，不认定全圈墙体已经发掘；夹城、子城不合并为同一期实测外界。文章龙山门的玉皇山脚解释与既有六和塔西地段说有差别，原有门址地段不据此移动。原1985年东侧开放线保留审计，显示由本方案替代，避免平行重复。图示参考，非实测墙界。
properties.enNote: Complete schematic circuit digitized from the Luocheng figure in the 26 January 2026 Hangzhou historical-study article. Its northern projection and southern mountain enclosure provide an independent comparison for the user screenshot; this does not establish the screenshot provenance. A uniform similarity fit uses schematic Baoshi, Wu, Fenghuang and Yuhuang mountain peaks against OSM summits, with control residuals of about 72–316 m. An independent Drum Tower reference differs by about 140 m; neither figure establishes wall accuracy. Peak symbols, historical names and source distortion add uncertainty. The closed circuit expresses this reconstruction only, not a fully excavated wall. Existing gate candidates are retained, including a competing Longshan Gate interpretation. The earlier open eastern trace remains in the audit and is superseded in display.
properties.locationPrecision: 山峰地望等比近似落位；控制点残差约72—316米，不代表墙界精度

This open drawing segment does not reconstruct its entire mountain circuit; it is neither extended nor filled. A higher-resolution original and further location checks remain necessary.

properties.note: 虞家钧《杭州沿革和城市发展》（1985）图2的东汉城垣研究示意，按原图闭合轮廓描绘；现代参照点拟合残差约274米，只表明本图较粗，不是墙基测量。县治迁徙和城址范围有不同考证，不能据此认定已发现完整东汉城墙。这里是杭州地区县城沿革，不新增东汉国都身份。
properties.enNote: Closed contour digitized from Yu Jiajun’s 1985 historical-geography sketch. The roughly 274 m fitting RMS shows its schematic nature, not archaeological accuracy. The location and extent remain debated. This county-town stage does not establish a Han national capital.
properties.locationPrecision: 历史地理学说示意，城垣尚无完整考古确认

corrections.reason: 2026-10-22复核1985年原文图2：此前北部小闭合面未忠实追踪图例中的东汉城垣，不能作为原图转绘成果；撤下其范围、填充与标签。原错误像素及几何仅留审计，不重新猜画。配准残差不能证明线型识别正确或城界精度。
逐段复核＋记号线型，修正西缘和南缘；弃用原六点仿射，以原图比例尺等比近似落位。原撤下版本继续留审计。
